from dotenv import load_dotenv; load_dotenv\(\)
from api.services.pdf_extractor import extract_pdf
from api.services.config_generator import _formatiere_tabellen, _lade_prompt
from api.services.ai_client import call_claude
from pathlib import Path
import re, yaml

pdf = Path\('data/eingang/2026/elektroniker/pruefung.pdf'\)
seiten = extract_pdf\(pdf\)
system = _lade_prompt\('system_prompt.txt'\)
template = _lade_prompt\('user_prompt_template.txt'\)
tabellen_text = _formatiere_tabellen\(seiten\)
user = template.format\(beruf='elektroniker', seitenanzahl=len\(seiten\), tabellen_rohinhalt=tabellen_text\)
antwort = call_claude\(system, user\)

# Regex-Match prüfen
match = re.search\(r'\\`\\`\\`\(?:yaml\)?\\n\(.*?\)\\`\\`\\`', antwort, re.DOTALL\)
print\('Regex-Match:', bool\(match\)\)
roh = match.group\(1\) if match else antwort.strip\(\)
print\('=== ROH \(erste 300 Zeichen\) ==='\)
print\(roh[:300]\)
print\('=== LETZTEN 200 Zeichen ==='\)
print\(roh[-200:]\)
try:
    result = yaml.safe_load\(roh\)
    print\('YAML OK:', list\(result.keys\(\)\)\)
except yaml.YAMLError as e:
    print\('YAML-FEHLER:', e\)
" 2>&1)
